subject.title: feat(sessions): upstream liveness for adopted catalog sessions

question: Should the permanent Plugin SDK expose a generic opaque upstream-session observer contract, or should adopted-session liveness remain provider-local until the broader SessionObserver design is approved?
rationale: This PR expands a public compatibility-sensitive SDK and chooses an owner boundary that repository policy cannot settle mechanically; the security defects are repairable only after the permanent identity and provider-ownership contract is selected.

options.title: Approve generic observer seam
options.body: Define an opaque provider-owned source contract with agent-qualified identities, then repair this PR against that boundary.

options.title: Keep the feature provider-local
options.body: Remove the public SDK expansion and implement the first Claude/Codex probes behind plugin-local runtime surfaces while the broader observer design remains open.

options.title: Pause the implementation
options.body: Keep design work on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/104804 and close or supersede this branch once a narrower approved implementation exists.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observer seam
recommendation.body: Define an opaque provider-owned source contract with agent-qualified identities, then repair this PR against that boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged session-state work and ownership of the canonical observer-direction issue make them the best available decision owner.
